record_scope_reconstruction: Yacuiba and San José de Pocitos civic blockade of the international road bridge to Salvador Mazza, May 31–June 2, 2021. It prevented freight that was otherwise permitted through the pandemic regime. This event is distinct from the continuing legal passenger restriction and from separate Villazón or Bermejo protests.

source_checks.finding: Full El Deber report inspected: bridge connects Yacuiba/Pocitos with Salvador Mazza; protest lifted after dialogue invitation and freight access restored, pandemic restriction continued.
